description: Course-provided TSP readiness and experiment suites, plus public known-optimum and open challenge collections.

structure_metadata.name: edge_weight_structure
structure_metadata.label: Edge-weight structure

values.uniform_euclidean: Cities are sampled approximately uniformly in a 2-D square; edge costs are TSPLIB EUC_2D distances.
values.clustered_euclidean: Cities are sampled around several spatial cluster centers; edge costs are TSPLIB EUC_2D distances.
values.random_weights: The complete graph has deterministic pseudo-random independent-looking integer edge weights and no underlying geometry.

structure_metadata.controlled: The required structure suite uses n=500 for every instance and three independently generated instances per structure value.
